# Vendored libraries

Self-hosted copies, so the site doesn't depend on third-party CDNs at runtime.

| File | Version | Source | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gsap.min.js` | 3.12.5 | cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/ | GSAP Standard License (https://gsap.com/standard-license) |
| `ScrollTrigger.min.js` | 3.12.5 | cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/ | GSAP Standard License |
| `lenis.min.js` | 1.1.13 | unpkg.com/lenis@1.1.13/dist/ | MIT (https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis) |

To upgrade, replace the file with the same build from the new version and update this table.
